name: markdown-frontend
body: The scan must cover markdown documents as a first-class frontend: a markdown source file is scanned as a document whose headings are section symbols, under a new `md` language id, with the same exactness posture as the code frontends. This closes the documentation gap — today .md files are not scanned at all (no md language id, no detector, no code-type arm), so docs are absent from the graph. Decomposes into extension acceptance, sections-as-symbols, language plumbing/detection, code-type classification, and build+acceptance. Markdown links (link references becoming graph edges) are DEFERRED — a later feature, out of scope for this change-set (see requirements.note.markdown-links-deferred); the synthesized document-root Struct existed only to anchor links and is retired with them. Feature markdown-frontend.
